agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state/code and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
v2.1 direct projection keeps DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND operational-only; they must not become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.
Strict boolean validation is useful type hardening but is not provenance, freshness, verifier authority or acceptance proof.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and does not itself raise gear; keep it observational until independently derived and tested.
The v2.1 contract correctly marks speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: New material objection: GearboxV2Decision carries checkpoint_required, receiver_ack_required, verification_gate, real_experience_claim_allowed and pressure_score, but GearboxV21Decision drops those inherited safety/verification fields. A downstream consumer of only the v2.1 decision can therefore lose checkpoint, ACK or verification-gate semantics even when the selected gear itself is inherited from v2.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must re-project all safety-critical inherited v2 metadata or bind an exact inherited_v2_decision fingerprint/reference that downstream must resolve. v2.1 may add restrictions but must never erase checkpoint_required, receiver_ack_required, verification_gate or real_experience_claim_allowed semantics.

disagreements.finding: v2 requires C_VERIFIED before real_experience_claim_allowed, but v2.1 recomputes verified_experience_delta from caller event_kind plus event_independently_verified without the inherited verification-stage gate.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero authoritative verified delta must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt binding exact evidence identity, trusted C/independent-verifier receipt and canonical verification stage; receipt-less or non-C_VERIFIED calls emit zero authoritative verified credit.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; a literal True can label stale telemetry as fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and runtime/installation identity are not bound.
disagreements.required_change: Require a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted source/freshness metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=True only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN. It does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision; permissive caller kwargs still control routing.
disagreements.required_change: Project the exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: Secretary freshness gates secretary_level only. Numeric pressure inputs lack per-field provenance/freshness, so stale secretary-derived telemetry can still force checkpoint/downshift.
disagreements.required_change: Bind source/freshness per pressure component; stale secretary-derived components contribute zero while independently trusted fresh telemetry may contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; a 1/1 sample can appear as 100% thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release. Numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is currently harmless reason-only metadata, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if later connected directly to upshift/retention authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from a precommitted denominator/window and tested against self-reinforcement.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate call. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay NO_OP, same-evidence/new-ID lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events forms event identity with str(event_id).strip(), allowing arbitrary caller types, numeric/string aliasing and unstable structured identities.
disagreements.required_change: Define a strict versioned EventIdentity boundary and bind accepted identity to canonical event/evidence/verifier acceptance state.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind plus booleans/stage labels; exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt are not mandatory in the executable path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields instead of consuming an accepted ledger receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero verified or operational credit must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta even though v2.1 defines them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify v2/v2.1 authoritative classification into verified_experience_delta versus operational_progress_delta; operational events must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Dropping inherited v2 safety metadata can silently remove checkpoint/ACK/verification constraints from downstream v2.1 behavior and invalidate paired comparisons.
Caller-declared secretary freshness/authority and unbound pressure provenance invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if policy-created progress is later fed back into routing authority.
Transient/noncanonical event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and direct credit bypass can inflate or censor longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Cross-layer v2/v2.1 Experience semantics can count the same event differently and contaminate model-selection analysis.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-INHERITED-SAFETY-METADATA-107: create a v2 decision with checkpoint_required=true, receiver_ack_required=true and verification_gate=NOT_PROMOTION_EVIDENCE; v2.1 must preserve the exact safety fields or expose a bound inherited-decision reference.
GB21-INHERITED-SAFETY-FINGERPRINT-108: mutate inherited checkpoint/ACK/verification metadata after v2 decision formation; v2.1 must reject mismatch.
GB21-V21-STAGE-BYPASS-105 + STAGE-CONSISTENCY-106: non-C_VERIFIED or receipt-less verified events produce zero authoritative v2.1 verified credit and v2/v2.1 consume one eligibility result.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE-109: stale signal plus caller fresh=true must be rejected by trusted freshness metadata.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery must project G1 despite permissive fallback kwargs.
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived pressure fields are ignored while trusted independent telemetry remains usable.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing, Experience, promotion or authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-TYPE-098 + EVENT-ID-ALIAS-099 + EVENT-ID-STRUCTURAL-100: adoptable event identity rejects arbitrary types and uses deterministic canonical semantics.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen metric provenance, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.

required_before_any_formal_adoption: Preserve Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 verified foundation; candidate failure rolls back only v2/v2.1 delta.
Resolve inherited-v2 safety metadata preservation with exact bound projection or inherited-decision fingerprint/reference.
Replace caller-declared secretary freshness/authority conflict with trusted replay-resistant signal and authority envelopes; fresh authority decision must actually be projected.
Bind pressure telemetry per field to source/freshness and prevent stale secretary side-channel routing effects.
Derive anti-thrash from canonical shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and stateful release; prove performance non-regression.
Keep verified_progress_density observational until independently derived and tested against self-reinforcement.
Implement durable rollback-resistant EventIdentity/evidence-lineage registry with exact replay NO_OP and rebinding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
Require exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt for any verified Experience.
Eliminate decision-path credit minting; all verified and operational credit must project from immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt.
Unify v2/v2.1 verified-vs-operational classification and prohibit operational progress from authoritative Experience-labelled fields.
Treat 5/4/3/1 credit weights as heuristic only; no capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/promotion inference from totals.

Establish speedup only through sealed matched paired/crossover baseline over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order/coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Obtain exact-current executable evidence, dedicated Spirit adversarial review, fresh Navigator synthesis and then use the existing A->B->C route; this W02 review never substitutes for C.
forbidden_claims: formal C PASS from this review
capability or consciousness from Experience credit totals
speedup from commit count, wake count, window age or awake time
